description: Test suite for avatar policy helper functions, verifying various URL and path helper behaviors related to avatar path handling.

methods.name: hasAvatarUriScheme
methods.description: Checks if a URL string has an avatar-related URI scheme.

methods.name: isAvatarDataUrl
methods.description: Checks if a string is an avatar data URL.

methods.name: isAvatarHttpUrl
methods.description: Checks if a string is an avatar HTTP(S) URL.

methods.name: isAvatarImageDataUrl
methods.description: Checks if a string is an avatar image data URL.

methods.name: isPathWithinRoot
methods.description: Checks if a given path is within a specified root path.

methods.name: isSupportedLocalAvatarExtension
methods.description: Checks if a file extension is a supported avatar image format.

methods.name: isWindowsAbsolutePath
methods.description: Checks if a path is a Windows absolute path.

methods.name: isWorkspaceRelativeAvatarPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is a workspace-relative avatar path.

methods.name: looksLikeAvatarPath
methods.description: Determines if a filename string looks like an avatar image path.

methods.name: resolveAvatarMime
methods.description: Resolves the MIME type based on file extension.
